items.content_html: Ferric is a lightweight, fast, and modern desktop SSH client. The backend is powered by a pure-Rust protocol stack — russh / russh-sftp — so it does not shell out to the system ssh binary. The frontend is built with React 19 + Tailwind CSS and packaged as a native desktop app via Tauri.
